notes.title: 1,000 wishlists and demo release date! Thank you for your support!
notes.notes: [p]As a solo developer, it's incredibly exciting for me to see that [b]over 1,000 people[/b] are genuinely interested in my first Steam release.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Overcome Your Fears[/b] will participate in the upcoming Steam Next Fest![/p][p]On [b]October 13th[/b], a short demo version will be released that will let you experience the overall atmosphere of the game. I would be incredibly grateful if you play it and leave your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Also, for those who want to chat, I've created a [b]Discord[/b] server. I'd be happy to see you there - [url="https://discord.gg/PP85J9mC7g"]discord.gg/PP85J9mC7g[/url][/p][p][/p][p]More to come! Once again, thank you so much for your attention to the game - every [b]Wishlist[/b] and [b]Follow[/b] is incredibly motivating![/p]
